calibration_firewall.prohibited_information: No forward returns, wins, P&L, exit outcomes, side/session outcome slices, or economic result from the candidate mechanism was inspected to select the fixture.
calibration_firewall.selection_reason: Rounded common M1/M5 p25 ratio to create an operational but selective accumulation population before any economic test.

source_basis.tradingview: Public open-source description: last-N range <= k*ATR starts accumulation; local volume-at-price profile; confirmed breakout freezes POC/VA; wait for POC-zone pullback; confirmed close back through POC triggers continuation; confirmed bars only.

semantic_repair.abandon_multiple_interpretation: Project-defined: abandon when developing box height exceeds 1.5x its initial detected box height. The indexed source says 'abandon multiple' but does not expose numeric/source-code expression; this interpretation is explicit and frozen before economics.
semantic_repair.reason: The 17BO fixture applied abandon multiple to ATR despite the initial box itself requiring a much larger N-bar range/ATR ratio; that combination was internally inconsistent for an operational XAU accumulation box.

gates.advance_rule: Advance unchanged profile only if all activity gates and nonnegative direct net pass.
